wins.claim: KerfDesk ships true medial-axis V-carving with a flat-depth cap and two-stage clearing for free while MillMage 0.8.02 has none (unreleased Pro feature).
KerfDesk ships a full STL-to-heightmap rough+finish relief pipeline with a 3D pane; MillMage 0.8.02 has no relief or STL machining.
KerfDesk's parametric V-carve toolpath is free; Easel's V-Carve Projects are a $24/mo Pro guided project type without flat-depth control.
Two pocket strategies (contour-parallel rings plus raster serpentine) with island handling and stepover control versus Easel's single simplified pocket fill.

gaps.claim: One hard-coded peck-at-bbox-center behavior versus MillMage's Plunge/Peck/Spot/Countersink drill editor with dwell and retract control.
No lead-in/out, no user start-point control, no separate last pass, and plunge/ramp-only entry versus VCarve's reference-grade profile form.
No rest machining or multi-tool clearance for 2D pockets, no adaptive strategy, and no wall finish allowance.
Auto tabs only with no manual/drag placement and no arc leads; the tabs-off full-depth default divergence from Easel cites a nonexistent ADR (section 5.6 severity bump).
No stock-to-leave, machining allowance, or separate finish pass exists for any 2D operation.
Tools store no per-tool feeds/flutes and the chipload chart is provisional and never cut-validated, versus per-machine material-specific tool databases.
No Photo V-Carve, Prism, or Inlay toolpaths, and carved-letter quality has never been compared side by side.
No image-as-heightmap route, no 3D components or textures, and STL import is reachable only via drag-and-drop (S8-F5).

notVerified: Sector-wide: no KerfDesk CNC toolpath has ever been cut on a machine - every CNC hardware pass is CLAIMED per the standing ledger; accuracy, chip evacuation, tab strength, floor precision, and climb/conventional behavior are design-intent claims

7.2: pocket floor coverage (no uncut slivers between rings/sweeps) asserted structurally only, never rendered or cut (also flagged by 2026-07-10 full-sweep audit)
7.3: bbox-center drilling of non-circular closed shapes never compared against any reference CAM
7.4: perceptual test is analytic (removal grid vs formula), not a rendered visual or a real cut; carve quality never compared vs VCarve/Carbide Create; sharp corners verified only on a square fixture
7.5: the claimed 'CNC-defaults ADR' recording the tabs-off default divergence does not exist in DECISIONS.md (grep-refuted) - un-ADR'd doc drift; physical tab strength never cut
7.6: floor precision at -depth is a machine claim; stock-to-leave absence concluded from CncLayerSettings source, not a UI walk
7.7: chipload numbers are provisional and never cut-validated; full tool-change flow verified only via streamer unit tests, never on a machine or live app
7.8: no perceptual/visual verification of carved relief output (terraces, scallops) - relief tests analytic; live 3D-pane behavior on large meshes not exercised
